clips.title: The story
paras: At Deathknell, Executor Arren directs the settlement's defense as new undead rise from their graves. He leads efforts against Scourge zombies, wild beasts, and threats to the Forsaken.

Executor Arren directs Deathknell's defense from outside its chapel. While caretakers in the crypts guide newly risen undead through their confusion, Arren turns their attention to survival beyond the graves. Under Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's banner, he organizes efforts to clear mindless zombies from the village borders. The Forsaken secure ground here in the shadow of Lordaeron's fall.

Danger surrounds Deathknell beyond the confused newly risen. Under Arren's orders, scouts and initiates strike at the vicious spiders in Night Web's Hollow and hunt predators along the woodland edges. He calls on every capable hand to act, testing whether new arrivals can defend their second chance and serve the Dark Lady.
